checks.name: Isolated MLX experiment
runnerSummaries: 􁁛  Test run with 1 test in 0 suites passed after 256.082 seconds.

investigations: Initial MLX facade test compared cold loading against reseeded warm inference. Corrected to compare matching residency states; no RNG/runtime change.
Stopped an initial cache benchmark with per-layer synchronization; final experiment materializes six layers once per frame. Only completed results are reported.
limitations: Physical-device, thermal/energy, broader listening and minimum Swift 6.3 toolchain qualification remain open.
API inventory is macOS public declarations, not binary ABI certification; iOS/Catalyst checks are builds, not runtime acceptance.
Exact baseline Core ML/Plus audio covers English and Spanish; MLX facade/profile covers English CPU/GPU. Basic/Qwen and other-language real-model suites were not enabled.
Performance observations are from a shared workstation. Planning workload is synthetic; no general inference speedup is claimed.
Capacity-cache prototype remains test-only; full continuation/trim/reset and end-to-end candidate equivalence were not established.
Recovery tests simulate interrupted states/failures under existing host serialization; no power-loss durability or concurrent installation guarantee.
